about:
Solar Heat & Electric was founded in 1983 in Omaha, Nebraska, beginning with solar thermal and energy conservation under the leadership of solar visionary Michael Shonka. The company added solar electric as the technology matured, becoming the oldest and best-known designer and installer of solar systems in Nebraska, with projects extending into Iowa.

The firm designs and installs grid-tied solar photovoltaic systems ranging from residential rooftops to utility-scale arrays, including 25 kW and 50 kW installations. Its capabilities span solar thermal, energy conservation consulting, net-metering interconnection, community solar development, and specialized applications such as center-pivot irrigation and aquaponics systems. The company also developed a solar training curriculum for Nebraska community colleges.

Solar Heat & Electric serves residential, agricultural, commercial, and municipal customers. Notable installations include the Winnebago Police/Fire Station in collaboration with the Ponca Tribe, Bellevue and Lincoln police stations, the Army Corps of Engineers’ 50 kW water-pumping system, Metropolitan Community College’s solar lab, Creighton University’s Kiewit Fitness Center array, Lincoln Electric Systems’ 200-module service center roof, and Central City’s first community solar project.

The company emphasizes its three-decade track record and NABCEP-certified installation expertise as risk reducers for clients. Michael Shonka’s university teaching and association leadership further underscore the depth of technical knowledge applied to every project.
